mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a sizzling ninety-one degrees outside the Verona Public Library, feeling like a sticky ninety-four under these clear skies, so please stay hydrated. If you want to keep our city green, remember you can drop off compostable food scraps at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop. In police news, a motorcyclist without a license plate fled from an officer at high speed, blowing through multiple red traffic lights. Finally, Culvers is closed right now, but they open in the morning at 10:00 AM. Rest up, because tomorrows flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl!
